facilities.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880251&siteId=23609 ('There are no electric, water, sewer hook-ups, or dump stations on state forest land. Campers are advised to bring their own water') + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/delaware/camping ('There are no developed facilities, modern conveniences, or other improvements at state forest campsites'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: A single roadside site, E016 Fivemile Meadow (Edgemere loop), on Five Mile Meadow Road just south of PA 739, about 5.8 miles north of Silver Lake Road. Pull-in, max vehicle length 30 ft; site 30 x 25 ft with a 105-ft gravel driveway, 15-ft overhead clearance, partial shade.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880251&siteId=23609 ('Max Vehicle Length: 30', 'Driveway Entry: Pull-In', 'Driveway Surface: Gravel', 'Driveway Length: 105', 'Site Length: 30', 'Site Width: 25', 'Site Height/Overhead Clearance: 15'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: A permit and reservation are always required; reserve online or at 888-PA-PARKS. Check-in and check-out 3 pm; campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/delaware/camping ('Camping permits and reservations are required to stay at motorized, roadside campsites', 'may be reserved up to eleven months in advance', 'Stays are limited to seven nights at a motorized, roadside campsite', 'Campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning') + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880251&siteId=23609 ('Site Reserve Type: Site-Specific'); noon cutoff as recorded from the DCNR motorized roadside camping page, read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed reservable on ReserveAmerica 11 months ahead, 7-night limit. Added no hookups/water/dump/showers, a single pull-in roadside site (E016 Fivemile Meadow) with a 30-ft max vehicle length and 105-ft gravel driveway, reservation always required (fcfs never), open year round, 48-hour vacate rule. Fees left at the DCNR state forest rate.
